resources.string: wuDict reads dictionaries from the shared “Dictionaries” folder (Internal storage → Dictionaries). Choose “Grant access” and allow All files access on the next screen, then copy your .mdx/.mdd, .ifo, .slob, .dsl, .bgl, .zim and .wudict.md files into that folder.

For testing on your own network. Other devices can reach the library only while wuDict is open on screen; closing it or turning the screen off ends access shortly after. Access is tied to the network the app started on: on another network it stops until you reopen the app. While it is on, any device on that network can read your library, without a password. Default: off.
